1. Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Fitness Custom Values:

1. Boxing Classes Calendar Link

Description: This value holds the URL to the boxing classes appointment scheduling calendar.

2. Free 10 Day Pass Calendar Link

Description: This value holds the URL to the free 10 day pass appointment scheduling calendar.

3. Personal Training Calendar Link

Description: This value holds the URL to your personal training appointment scheduling calendar.

4. Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Description: This value is the URL for a targeted campaign to collect Google reviews from clients.

7. Service Area

Description: This value holds the URL of the location of the gym.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

This Gym Snapshot includes seven fully automated pipelines designed to streamline your gym's operations and enhance member engagement. Each pipeline is meticulously crafted to cover every aspect of your gym's workflow, from lead acquisition to member retention.

14-Day Free Trial Pipeline

This pipeline is designed for individuals who opt into the 14-day free trial funnel, providing a seamless experience from the moment they express interest to their transition into a paying customer or cancellation.

Pipeline Stages:

Opt-In:

This stage captures and records the initial interest of the individual opting into the 14-day free trial.

Automated confirmation and welcome emails are sent to acknowledge their registration and provide further instructions.

Trial Started:

Once the trial begins, the individual is moved to this stage.

Paying Customer:

If the individual decides to convert to a paying customer before or at the end of the trial, they are moved to this stage.

Canceled:

If the individual decides not to continue after the trial period, they are moved to this stage.

This pipeline ensures that every individual who opts into the 14-day free trial is guided through a structured process, maximizing the chances of conversion while providing valuable insights into their experience.

Boxing Classes Pipeline

This pipeline is tailored for individuals who enter through the boxing funnel, providing a clear and structured journey from initial interest to becoming a paying customer.

Pipeline Stages:

New Lead:

Captures and records the initial interest of individuals who inquire about the boxing classes.

Automated confirmation emails or SMS are sent to acknowledge their interest and provide introductory information.

Lead Responded:

Once the lead responds to the initial communication, they are moved to this stage.

Appt Booked:

When the lead books an appointment for a trial class or consultation, they move to this stage.

Automated reminders and confirmations are sent to ensure they remember their appointment.

Appt No Show:

If the lead does not show up for their scheduled appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Appt Canceled:

If the lead cancels their appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Paid:

When the lead makes a payment for the boxing classes, they are moved to this stage.

Follow Up:

Continuous follow-up messages are sent to keep the customer engaged, gather feedback, and offer additional classes or membership options.

This pipeline ensures that every individual interested in boxing classes is guided through a structured process, enhancing the likelihood of conversion and providing a seamless experience from start to finish.

Database Reactivation Pipeline

This pipeline is designed to track the progress of a database reactivation campaign, ensuring efficient follow-up and engagement with past contacts.

Pipeline Stages:

Offer Sent:

Initial stage where the reactivation offer is sent to the database contacts.

Automated emails or SMS messages are sent, detailing the reactivation offer and encouraging recipients to respond.

Replied Yes:

When a contact responds positively to the offer, they are moved to this stage.

Replied Other Than Yes:

If a contact replies with any response other than "Yes" (e.g., questions, requests for more information, or tentative interest), they are moved to this stage.

Not Interested:

Contacts who indicate they are not interested in the reactivation offer are moved to this stage.

This pipeline ensures a structured approach to reactivating your database, maximizing the chances of re-engaging past contacts while efficiently managing responses.

Free 10 day pass pipeline

This pipeline is tailored for individuals who enter through the free 10-day pass funnel, providing a comprehensive and structured journey from opting in for the pass to potentially becoming a long-term member.

Pipeline Stages:

Offer Opt-In:

Captures and records the initial interest of individuals opting in for the free 10-day pass.

Automated confirmation emails or SMS messages are sent to acknowledge their registration and provide further instructions.

Appt Booked:

Once the individual books an appointment to start their 10-day pass, they move to this stage.

Automated reminders and confirmations are sent to ensure they remember their appointment.

Appt Canceled:

If the individual cancels their appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Appt No Show:

If the individual does not show up for their scheduled appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Automated messages are sent to reschedule the appointment and understand the reason for the no-show.

Offer Redeemed:

When the individual redeems their free 10-day pass and begins their trial period, they are moved to this stage.

Canceled After 10 Days:

If the individual decides not to continue after the 10-day pass, they are moved to this stage.

Purchased Membership:

If the individual decides to purchase a membership before or at the end of the 10-day pass, they are moved to this stage.

Membership Canceled:

If the individual cancels their membership at any point, they are moved to this stage.

This pipeline ensures that every individual who opts into the free 10-day pass is guided through a structured process, maximizing the chances of conversion while providing valuable insights into their experience.

Google Review Campaign Pipeline

This pipeline is designed to track the progress and effectiveness of a Google review campaign, ensuring efficient follow-up and engagement to maximize positive reviews.

Pipeline Stages:

Request Sent:

Initial stage where the request for a Google review is sent to the customers.

Automated emails or SMS messages are sent, encouraging customers to leave a review and providing the review link.

Review Link Clicked:

When a customer clicks on the review link, they are moved to this stage.

Review Link Not Clicked:

If the customer does not click on the review link within a specified period, they are moved to this stage.

This pipeline ensures a structured approach to managing your Google review campaign, enhancing customer engagement and maximizing the chances of receiving positive reviews.

Main Gym Pipeline

This pipeline is designed to manage and track any other gym leads that come through various channels, ensuring a comprehensive and organized approach to converting leads into long-term members.

Pipeline Stages:

New Lead:

Captures and records the initial interest of individuals who inquire about the gym through any channel.

Lead Responded:

Once the lead responds to the initial communication, they are moved to this stage.

Appt Booked:

When the lead books an appointment for a trial class, consultation, or gym tour, they move to this stage.

Membership Purchased:

If the lead decides to purchase a membership, they are moved to this stage.

Membership Canceled:

If the individual cancels their membership at any point, they are moved to this stage.

Follow Up:

Continuous follow-up messages are sent to keep the lead or member engaged, gather feedback, and offer additional classes, programs, or membership options.

This pipeline ensures that all gym leads are effectively managed and nurtured through a structured process, enhancing the likelihood of conversion and providing a seamless experience from initial inquiry to long-term membership.

Personal Trainer Pipeline

This pipeline is designed to manage and track leads and clients for personal training services, ensuring a smooth and organized process from initial contact to ongoing training sessions.

Pipeline Stages:

New Lead:

Captures and records the initial interest of individuals who inquire about personal training services.

Hot Lead:

When a lead shows a high level of interest or is deemed a strong potential client, they are moved to this stage.

Appt Booked:

When the lead books an appointment for a consultation or trial session, they move to this stage.

Appt Canceled:

If the lead cancels their appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Appt No Show:

If the lead does not show up for their scheduled appointment, they are moved to this stage.

Follow Up:

Continuous follow-up messages are sent to keep the lead engaged, gather feedback, and encourage them to book an appointment or take further steps.

Client Onboarding:

When the lead becomes a client and starts the onboarding process, they are moved to this stage.

Client Training:

Active clients who are currently undergoing training sessions are moved to this stage.

Services Canceled:

If the client decides to cancel the personal training services, they are moved to this stage.

This pipeline ensures that all personal training leads and clients are effectively managed and nurtured through a structured process, enhancing the likelihood of conversion and providing a seamless experience from initial inquiry to ongoing training.

3. Calendars

The snapshot includes various calendars designed to streamline scheduling and enhance customer engagement. Each calendar is paired with a corresponding funnel to ensure seamless integration and automation.

Day Pass Calendar

Purpose: Manages appointments and scheduling for individuals who opt for a day pass.

Funnel: Day Pass Funnel

Functionality: Automatically sends confirmation emails, reminders, and follow-up messages to ensure a smooth experience for day pass users.

Free 10-Day Pass Calendar

Purpose: Manages appointments and scheduling for individuals who opt for the free 10-day pass.

Funnel: Free 10-Day Pass Funnel

Functionality: Automates the scheduling process, sends reminders, and follow-ups throughout the 10-day trial period to maximize engagement and conversion.

Fitness Calendar

Purpose: Manages general fitness class schedules and bookings.

Functionality: Streamlines class bookings, sends automated reminders, and provides updates about class schedules and changes.

Personal Training Calendar

Purpose: Manages appointments and scheduling for personal training sessions.

Funnel: Personal Training Funnel

Functionality: Handles scheduling for consultations, trial sessions, and ongoing personal training appointments, with automated reminders and follow-up communications.

Boxing Classes Calendar

Purpose: Manages appointments and scheduling for boxing classes.

Funnel: Boxing Classes Funnel

Functionality: Automates the booking process for boxing classes, sends reminders, and follows up with participants to ensure engagement and retention.

Each calendar is fully integrated with its respective funnel, ensuring a cohesive and automated workflow from lead generation to booking and follow-up. This integration enhances the overall efficiency of the gym’s operations, providing a seamless experience for both the staff and the members.

Setting Up the Appointment Calendar

1. Accessing the Calendar Setup

Step 1: Log in to your GoHighLevel account. Step 2: Navigate to the “Calendars” section in the main menu. Step 3: Click on “New Calendar” to start the setup process.

2. Configuring Calendar Settings

Calendar Name: Enter a name for your calendar (e.g., "Gym Appointments").

Timezone: Select the appropriate timezone for your location.

Calendar View: Choose the default view (e.g., daily, weekly) that you prefer.

3. Service Setup

Add Services: Click on “Add Service” to list all the services your gym offers.

Service Name: Enter the name of the service (e.g., "Personal Training Session").

Duration: Specify the duration of each service (e.g., 60 minutes).

Price: Enter the price of the service.

Description: Provide a brief description of the service.

Service Categories: Organize services into categories for easier navigation.

4. Staff Management

Add Staff: Click on “Add Staff” to include team members who will provide services.

Staff Name: Enter the name of the staff member.

Email: Provide the staff member's email address.

Services: Assign services to each staff member based on their expertise.

Availability: Set the working hours and days for each staff member.

5. Booking Rules

Appointment Buffers: Set buffer times between appointments to allow for preparation and cleaning.

Cancellation Policy: Define the cancellation policy (e.g., 24-hour notice required).

Max Appointments: Limit the number of appointments a client can book in a day.

Using the Appointment Calendar

1. Client Booking Process

Step 1: Clients visit your gym’s website and navigate to the appointment booking page. Step 2: They select the desired service from the list. Step 3: Choose a preferred date and time from the available slots. Step 4: Enter personal details (name, contact information). Step 5: Confirm the booking. Clients receive a confirmation email with appointment details.

2. Managing Appointments

View Appointments: Access the calendar to see all scheduled appointments.

Reschedule/Cancel: Click on an appointment to reschedule or cancel if necessary.

Appointment Details: View details of each appointment, including client information and service booked.

3. Automated Reminders

Email/SMS Reminders: Set up automated reminders to be sent to clients via email or SMS before their appointments.

Custom Messages: Customize the reminder messages to include specific instructions or information.

Advanced Features

1. Calendar Sync

Integration: Sync the appointment calendar with Google Calendar, Outlook, or other calendar applications.

Real-Time Updates: Ensure that any changes made in the appointment calendar are reflected in the synced calendars.

2. Reporting and Analytics

Appointment Reports: Generate reports to analyze booking patterns, peak times, and staff performance.

Client Insights: Gather insights on client preferences and booking behavior.

3. Promotional Offers

Special Offers: Highlight special promotions or packages on the booking page.

Discount Codes: Allow clients to enter discount codes when booking to receive promotional rates.

Best Practices

Regular Updates: Keep the calendar updated with any changes in availability, services, or staff schedules.

Client Communication: Ensure timely communication with clients regarding their appointments and any changes.

Feedback Collection: After each appointment, send a follow-up message requesting client feedback to improve services.

Troubleshooting

Appointment Conflicts: Ensure buffer times are set correctly to avoid overlapping appointments.

Email Deliverability: Check email settings if clients report not receiving confirmation or reminder emails.

Calendar Sync Issues: Re-sync calendars periodically to ensure all appointments are up-to-date.

By following this documentation, you can effectively set up and manage your gym appointment calendar, ensuring a seamless booking experience for your clients and efficient appointment management for your staff.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Automating your appointment communications ensures a seamless experience for both your clients and staff, reducing no-shows and cancellations while enhancing engagement and efficiency. Each calendar in the snapshot is fully automated with workflows designed to handle various appointment scenarios. These automations are organized into five main folders based on the service offerings:

Workflows and Automation Folders

Boxing Offer

Appointment Confirmation: Sends an immediate confirmation email/SMS upon booking.

Reminder: Sends a reminder 30 minutes before the appointment.

Cancellation: Automates the process of acknowledging and recording cancellations.

No-Show: Sends follow-up messages to reschedule if the client misses their appointment.

Free 10-Day Pass

Appointment Confirmation: Sends a confirmation message with details about the 10-day pass.

Reminder: Reminds clients of their scheduled visits 30 minutes before.

Cancellation: Handles cancellations and sends a confirmation message.

No-Show: Sends a follow-up to reschedule if the client misses any of their free 10-day pass appointments.

Personal Training

Appointment Confirmation: Confirms the booking for personal training sessions.

Reminder: Sends a reminder 30 minutes before the session.

Cancellation: Automates the process of acknowledging and recording cancellations.

No-Show: Sends a follow-up message to reschedule missed personal training sessions.

Automation Details

Appointment Confirmation:

Trigger: Upon booking.

Action: Sends an immediate confirmation email/SMS with appointment details and any necessary instructions.

Reminder:

Trigger: 30 minutes before the appointment.

Action: Sends automated reminders to ensure clients remember their appointments, reducing no-show rates.

Cancellation:

Trigger: When a client cancels an appointment.

Action: Sends an acknowledgment of the cancellation and updates the calendar accordingly. May also provide options to reschedule.

No-Show:

Trigger: If a client does not attend the appointment.

Action: Sends a follow-up message to inquire about rescheduling and understand the reason for the no-show.

Integration and Efficiency

These automated workflows are designed to provide a seamless experience, ensuring all communications are timely and relevant. By organizing these automations into the five service-specific folders, you can efficiently manage and customize the communication process for each type of appointment.

Implementing these automations will streamline your operations, enhance client satisfaction, and ensure that every appointment, from initial booking to follow-up, is handled smoothly and professionally.

4. Website

Snapshot Website Customization

Overview

Creating a professional and polished website is essential for your gym to attract potential members and provide them with necessary information about your services and programs. This documentation will guide you through the customization options available for your gym website, ensuring it reflects your brand identity and meets your business needs.

Customization Options

Add Your Logo Easily upload your logo to give your website a personalized touch. Your logo will seamlessly integrate into the design, enhancing brand recognition and professionalism. Steps:

Go to "Sites" in the main menu.

Select "Websites."

Click on the gym website template.

Navigate to the logo section and upload your logo file.

Adjust the size and placement as needed.

Customize Brand Colors Make your website truly yours by changing the brand colors to reflect your unique style and aesthetic. Choose from a wide range of color options to create a cohesive and visually appealing design. Steps:

Within the website editor, locate the theme or color settings.

Select your desired primary and secondary colors.

Preview the changes and ensure they align with your brand identity.

Save the changes to apply the new color scheme to your website.

Edit Content Tailor the content on your website to suit your specific business needs and messaging. Whether it's updating text, adding images, or modifying layouts, our user-friendly editor makes it easy to create compelling and engaging content. Steps:

Access the website editor through "Sites" > "Websites."

Click on the section you want to edit (e.g., About Us, Services).

Update the text, images, and layout using the drag-and-drop editor.

Preview your changes and make any necessary adjustments.

Save the changes to publish your updated content.

Auto-populated Business Information No need to manually update your business details on the website. Thanks to custom values, essential information such as your business name, phone number, email address, and physical address will automatically populate throughout the site, ensuring accuracy and consistency. Steps:

The business name, phone number, email address, and physical address will automatically be added to the site.

Ensure these values are correctly linked to the corresponding fields on your website.

Add Programs and Classes Highlight the various programs and classes your gym offers, such as personal training, group classes, and specialty programs. You can easily add sections to showcase these offerings. Steps:

In the website editor, navigate to the section where you want to add programs or classes.

Enter the program or class details, including name, description, schedule, and images.

Save the changes and publish the program or class section on your site.

Conclusion

With these powerful customization options, you can create a professional and polished website that effectively represents your gym's brand and attracts potential members. Whether you’re uploading your logo, customizing brand colors, editing content, auto-populating business information, or adding programs and classes, our user-friendly website editor makes it easy to build a site that meets your business needs.

Website Contact Us Form

Easily collect leads by utilizing a gym website form that will help you gather information about customers, including their name, email, phone number, the type of services they are looking for, and additional comments or questions.

Website Automations

If you navigate to the Automation tab, you will find a folder titled "Website Automations."

Inside the "Website Automations" folder, you will find three website automations.

Whenever someone interacts with your website form, webchat, or live chat, these automations will trigger. They will tag the lead, update their information in your pipeline, send them text and email follow-ups, and notify the gym that a new lead has been generated.

8. Database Reactivation

A Database Reactivation (DR) campaign is a targeted marketing strategy designed to re-engage inactive or unresponsive leads within your database. By offering a compelling incentive, such as a 10-day free pass to your gym, you can reignite interest and encourage these leads to return and take action.

Benefits of a DR Campaign

Re-engage Inactive Leads: Effectively reach out to leads who have previously shown interest but have become inactive.

Increased Engagement: Provide a valuable offer that entices leads to re-engage with your gym.

Boost Conversion Rates: Turn dormant leads into active members through a structured and appealing offer.

Enhanced Relationship Building: Re-establish connections with past leads and foster long-term relationships.

Optimized Database Utilization: Maximize the potential of your existing lead database by reactivating contacts.

9. Birthday Campaign Workflow

Gym Birthday Offer Documentation

Birthday offers are a fantastic way to celebrate with your members while also incentivizing them to enjoy your gym services. Our birthday offer allows you to show appreciation for your members' loyalty and encourage them to treat themselves on their special day with a generous offer: a FREE one-week gym pass plus 20% off any personal training package!

Overview

Our birthday offer is designed to delight your members on their birthdays and encourage them to enhance their fitness journey with a special experience at your gym. By providing a significant offer of a FREE one-week gym pass plus 20% off any personal training package, you can make their birthday celebration even more special while also driving additional business to your gym.

Key Features

FREE One-Week Gym Pass: Members can enjoy a free one-week pass to explore all the facilities and services your gym offers.

20% Off Personal Training Package: Members receive a 20% discount on any personal training package, encouraging them to kickstart or enhance their fitness journey.

Personalized Birthday Greeting: Send a personalized birthday message to members, expressing your gratitude for their patronage and extending the special offer.

Flexible Redemption: Members have the flexibility to choose any personal training package they desire.

Implementation

Implementing the birthday offer at your gym is simple and straightforward:

Identify Members' Birthdays: Utilize your member database to identify members whose birthdays are approaching.

Send Personalized Birthday Message: Send a personalized email or text message to members, wishing them a happy birthday and extending the free one-week pass and 20% discount offer.

Redemption:

Members can redeem the offer by visiting the gym and mentioning the birthday offer at the front desk.

Provide the one-week gym pass and apply the 20% discount on any personal training package they choose.

Track Redemptions: Keep track of the birthday offer redemptions to assess the effectiveness of the campaign and measure member engagement.

Benefits

Member Appreciation: Show appreciation for your members' loyalty and strengthen your relationship with them.

Increased Revenue: Drive additional business to your gym by incentivizing members to utilize the birthday offer.

Enhanced Member Experience: Provide members with a memorable birthday experience that they'll associate with your gym's exceptional service and care.

With our birthday offer, you can elevate your members' birthday celebrations and create lasting memories while also driving business growth for your gym.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the gym. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the Gym, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the Gym, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Google Review Campaign

Google Review Campaign Documentation

A Google Review campaign is an effective strategy to gather valuable feedback from your members and enhance your gym’s online reputation. Positive reviews can significantly impact your gym's visibility and credibility, attracting more potential members.

Overview

Our Google Review campaign is designed to encourage members to leave positive reviews about their experiences at your gym. By systematically reaching out to satisfied members and guiding them through the review process, you can build a robust collection of testimonials that highlight your gym’s strengths.

Key Features

Automated Review Requests: Automatically send review requests to members after their visits or classes.

Personalized Messaging: Send personalized messages to make the review request feel sincere and tailored.

Follow-Up Reminders: Send follow-up reminders to members who haven't left a review to increase the chances of receiving feedback.

Tracking and Reporting: Monitor the status of review requests and track the responses to assess the effectiveness of the campaign.

Enhanced Online Reputation: Positive reviews boost your gym’s credibility and attract potential members.

Increased Visibility: A higher number of positive reviews improves your gym’s ranking in Google search results.

Member Engagement: Engaging with members for reviews shows that you value their feedback and helps build a stronger community.

Actionable Insights: Reviews provide insights into what members love about your gym and areas for improvement.

By implementing this Google Review campaign, you can effectively gather positive feedback, enhance your gym’s online presence, and attract more potential members.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your gym but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your gym. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming members.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message

When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with the gym.

Call to Action

The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation or visit.

Personalization

To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.

Example of a Missed Call Text Message

Hi [Caller’s Name],

We noticed you tried to reach us at [Gym Name]. Sorry we missed your call! If you're interested in booking a consultation or a visit, you can easily do so by clicking the link below:

[Online Booking Link]

Or give us a call back at [Gym Phone Number]. We look forward to helping you reach your fitness goals!

Best regards,

[Gym Name] Team

Benefits

Immediate Engagement: Quickly respond to missed calls, ensuring potential members feel valued and attended to.

Increased Appointments: Provide an easy way for potential leads to book appointments or consultations, increasing the likelihood of conversion.

Enhanced Member Experience: Personalizing the message helps create a more engaging and relevant experience for potential members.

Efficiency: Automating the follow-up process saves time and ensures no lead is missed.

By implementing the Missed Call Text Back Automation, you can effectively manage missed calls, enhance engagement with potential members, and increase appointment bookings for your gym.

This documentation outlines the benefits and implementation of the missed call text back automation for your gym, ensuring you capture and convert potential leads even when they can't reach you by phone.
